RFC8654-3-1.note: New unit TestRFC8654ExtendedMessageSessionUsesRFC7606ErrorHandling runs on a live session that negotiated Extended Message (asserted) with UPDATEs over 4096 octets (1100 /24s). Positive: malformed ORIGIN length -> RFC 7606 treat-as-withdraw: no error, Established, no NOTIFICATION, all 1100 routes dispatched as withdrawn with no attributes. Negative: Total Attribute Length overruns the message -> RFC 7606 Section 3 b ("the Error Subcode MUST be set to Malformed Attribute List"): NOTIFICATION 3/1, Idle, nothing dispatched. Observed-red records: + revert enforceRFC7606, - revert rfc7606SessionReset. Replaces the old weak finding that only isolated ValidateUpdateRFC7606 calls were tagged; those stay as supplementary.

RFC8654-3-2.note: Code 6 is the whole obligation; row single-polarity positive (a fixed code has no refusal form). TestRFC8654ExtendedMessageWireIsCode6Length0 reads the octet WriteTo puts at a non-zero offset (06), Code()==6, and Parse(06 00) yields *ExtendedMessage: a code drift in WriteTo or in Parse's dispatch goes red. The old TestCapabilityCodeConstants tag (constant only) is supplementary. Judge 2026-09-30.

RFC8654-3-3.note: Positive: WriteTo writes exactly 06 00 with Len 2 and nothing beyond, Parse(06 00) accepted. Negative: TestRFC8654ExtendedMessageNonZeroLengthRefused sends code 6 with length 1 and 4 and requires ErrInvalidLength and no capability. Judge break: parseZeroLengthCapability accepting a non-zero length (len>8 guard) turned the negative red. Single-polarity marker removal is correct: a refusal path exists.

RFC8654-4-2.note: Non-compliant: an UPDATE on the wire larger than the negotiated maximum. TestSendUpdateWithSplitBoundsAnOversizePayload drives Peer.sendUpdateWithSplit with an over-4096 payload to a non-extended peer and asserts every wire frame length <= 4096 with the NLRI preserved; TestSendUpdateWithSplitTracksTheNegotiatedMaximum asserts the bound is 65535 when negotiated; BuildUnicastWithMaxSize refuses an oversize build (ErrUpdateTooLarge). Both polarities.

RFC8654-4-3.note: Non-compliant: an OPEN or KEEPALIVE allowed past 4096 because Extended Message was negotiated. TestValidateLengthWithMax requires an error for OPEN 4097 with extended=true (production gate: session_read.go:105 calls ValidateLengthWithMax); TestMaxMessageLength asserts OPEN and KEEPALIVE with extended both 4096, and UPDATE/NOTIFICATION/ROUTE-REFRESH 65535, covering the 'applies to all messages except' half.

RFC8654-5-1.note: Non-compliant: accepting a message over 4096 when the capability was not advertised. TestValidateLengthWithMax requires Error for UPDATE, NOTIFICATION and ROUTE-REFRESH of 4097 with extended=false and accepts 65535 with extended=true; production receive paths session_read.go:105 and session_coalesce.go:91 pass s.extendedMessage into the same gate.

RFC8654-5-4.note: RFC 4271 handling proven end to end: TestRFC8654OverLengthUpdateFollowsRFC4271ErrorHandling on an established session without Extended Message sends an UPDATE header Length 4097 and requires NOTIFICATION 1/2 with Data 0x1001 on the wire, ReadAndProcess erroring, and the connection closed (EOF). The bounds unit asserts code/subcode/Data; positive on the HEAD TestValidateLengthWithMax.

RFC8654-6-1.note: TestRFC8654LengthBoundsPerTypeAndCapability: per-type floors accepted in both capability states, 0 and 18 refused for every type, 4096 accepted and 4097 refused without the capability, 65535 accepted for UPDATE/NOTIFICATION/ROUTE-REFRESH with it, OPEN 4097/65535 refused with it; every refusal Bad Message Length with the erroneous Length as Data. KEEPALIVE's cap is held by its exact-19 per-type check (HEAD unit).
